decisions.reason: As a consumer superfood drink mix it sits far outside the firm's chemical and waste-conversion core, so even with some prior commitment management can more easily abandon it.

The modular waste-to-energy extensions fit the firm's industrial sustainability narrative, but the weaker public commitment makes it easier for management to discontinue them if results have been underwhelming.
This waste-oil-to-energy plant had the strongest and most visible public launch and is close to the firm's strategic direction, so escalation of commitment makes management likely to persist.

Plastic-waste-to-fuel is closely tied to the firm's announced circular-economy direction and received a dedicated product presentation, so management is inclined to continue and attribute setbacks to temporary factors.
